selection.name: Leech Seed
selection.description: The caster plants a life-sapping seed in an enemy unit, draining its health, while simultaneously slowing it. The seed heals friendly units around it.
selection.differences: Multiple Leech Seed debuffs can be placed on the same unit simultaneously.
selection.superUpgrade: Super: Turns into an area of effect spell where the hero spills a green puddle that leeches in a 300 unit radius. Increases movement slow by 15% and damage/heal per second by 50.

selection.name: Life Break
selection.description:
The hero draws upon their health to break an enemy's life, leaping at a target to shatter a percentage of their target's current health, and slowing them. While leaping, the hero is Spell Immune.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
selection.differences: AI: Targets the farthest unit from the hero.
selection.superUpgrade: Super: Deals 100% of self damage to the target enemy and all units that the hero passes through.
selection.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Life Break taunts the target for 3 seconds. Grants Gaben's Gauntlets, which has the value of 15 Gauntlets of Strength (+45 Strength).

selection.name: Life Drain
selection.description:
CHANNELED - When cast on an enemy, the caster drains health from the target enemy unit to heal himself and granting vision over the target. If the caster has full HP, and the enemy target is a Hero, Life Drain will restore mana instead.

When cast on an ally, the caster will drain his own health into his ally.
selection.differences: AI: heals allies if they're low HP, but only if caster is above 90% HP.
selection.superUpgrade: Super: For every 1 seconds of channel, another secondary Life Drain is created targeting another random enemy hero.
selection.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Removes cooldown and increases damage by 200.

selection.name: Lightning Bolt
selection.description: Calls down a bolt of lightning to strike an enemy unit, causing damage and a mini-stun. When cast, Lightning Bolt briefly provides unobstructed vision and True Sight around the target in a 750 radius. Can be cast on the ground, affecting the closest enemy hero in 425 range.
selection.superUpgrade: Super: Cast range increased by 1000. Grants Nimbus. Lightning Bolt now stuns for 1 seconds.

selection.name: Lil' Shredder
selection.description: Heats up a mounted turret to rapidly fire 6 fixed-damage attacks. Each attack reduces the enemy's armor. Provides bonus attack range for the duration.
